instruction: A pool-toy Tyrannosaurus rex made of glossy inflated vinyl, its plump body, stubby arms, and puffed tail seamed with welded ridges. The bright lime-green plastic catches broad glare highlights, and its cartoonish grin and tiny air-plug nub read as a bouncy blow-up toy.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Inflatable T-Rex in a inflatable style. A pool-toy Tyrannosaurus rex made of glossy inflated vinyl, its plump body, stubby arms, and puffed tail seamed with welded ridges. The bright lime-green plastic catches broad glare highlights, and its cartoonish grin and tiny air-plug nub read as a bouncy blow-up toy. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
